newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Berner plans to resume dividend in 97/98.
newsitem.headline: Berner plans to resume dividend in 97/98.

text.p: Swiss insurer Berner Holding AG plans to resume paying an appropriate dividend for the 1997/98 fiscal year after omitting a payout on 1996/97 results, chief executive Franz Manser told reporters
"From today's perspective an operating result is expected that will allow payment of an appropriate dividend," he said.

Berner, majority owned by Allianz, posted a group loss of 26.6 million Swiss francs in 1996/97. Berner took a 44.1 million franc charge to withdraw from the Spanish market. It had posted a profit of 18.5 million the previous year.
